mentions.name: nah
mentions.description: A coding agent guard that blocks catastrophic tool calls from AI coding agents. It is easily extensible, features a simple TUI, and is designed to stay resilient against an adversarial agent that attempts to remove the guard.
mentions.problem: AI coding agents can execute catastrophic tool calls, and an adversarial agent may attempt to remove the guard.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on nah, a coding agent guard to block catastrophic tool calls.

It’s easily extensible, has a nice simple TUI, and is resilient to an adversarial agent that tries to remove the guard.
mentions.author: schipperai
